sections.text_helper: Section 49.8.22 "CRYP context swap GCM registers (CRYP_CSGCMxR)" in chapter 49 (Cryptographic processor (CRYP)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2406.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x70 + 0x4 * x, (x=0 to 7)
Reset value: 0x00000000
Bits 31:0 CSGCM[31:0]: Context swap for GCM/GMAC modes
CRYP_CSGCMxR registers contain the complete internal register states of the CRYP when
the GCM or GMAC processing of the current task is suspended to process a higher-priority
task. Refer to Section49.4.8: CRYP suspend and resume operations for more details.
CRYP_CSGCMxR registers are not used in other chaining modes than GCM or GMAC.
